title: Grading the Unspoken: Evaluating Tacit Reasoning in Quantum Field Theory and String Theory with LLMs
summary: Large language models have demonstrated impressive performance across many domains of mathematics and physics. One natural question is whether such models can support research in highly abstract theoretical fields such as quantum field theory and string theory. Evaluating this possibility faces an immediate challenge: correctness in these domains is layered, tacit, and fundamentally non-binary.
